inputs.text: Seamless repeatable hand-painted videogame material. EXACTLY perpendicular flat full-frame macro albedo material scan, no perspective, no object silhouette. The entire square is one continuous surface, every edge and corner has the same density, scale and brightness. Painterly gouache brushwork with beautiful broad and medium shapes and sparse fine details. Unlit intrinsic colors, soft restrained contrast. No scenery, no landscape, no background, no border, no frame, no vignette, no cast shadows, no central highlight, no text. Light warm ochre clay and compacted sandy earth. Continuous flat soil with fine irregular painted ochre patches and a very few tiny cream grains and gray pebble dots. No visible path shape, no path edges, no grassy border, no footprints, no large pebbles. Quiet walking earth material with soft lovely brushwork.
